## About Motionflare

Motionflare is an AI marketing video generator that turns a URL or a single sentence into a finished marketing, product, or ads video in minutes. It auto-generates on-brand scenes, AI voiceover, subtitles, music, and supports image uploads. Motion Engine 2.0 delivers more than 160 motion recipes and visual style packs for fast, polished videos from any topic.

 Generate full marketing/product/ads videos from a URL or one sentence

 Fast production workflow — finished videos in minutes

## Who is this for?

Marketers, product teams, indie makers, and small agencies who need on-brand marketing, product, or ad videos quickly.

## Overview

Motionflare is an innovative web-based AI tool that facilitates the creation of on-brand marketing, advertising, and social videos. Upon providing a URL, Motionflare analyzes the website, extracting various elements such as logos, color schemes, and copy text, to create videos that align perfectly with a brand's identity.

It supports creation and customization of videos seamlessly in the browser, eliminating the need for asset libraries and traditional video editing processes.

The interface allows you to pick accents and music, seamlessly integrating them into the video. A unique feature of Motionflare is its ability to generate videos directly from a brief provided in a sentence format.
